lines.zh: 游过水面留下一圈圈波纹。
lines.en: Ripples spread as it swims.
Shimmers with gold, tail swaying.
Slips into shadow, avoiding light.
Stares,发出尖锐叫声尖锐 scream.
Swallows smaller fish, enjoys meal.
Swims towards the team, ready to attack.
One sweep of my tail and the ripples spread.
Drains souls with blood magic.
The sun is coming up. I need cover.
Jumps out, spraying water.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，水面裂成两半。
lines.en: One flick of my tail splits the water.
I swim across the river under moonlight.
My scales scrape the river stones.

lines.zh: 我绕着鬼杀队的营地转。
lines.en: I circle the Demon Slayer camp.
Keep the splash low. Do not wake the bank.
I swim toward the deeper shade.
The riverbed's wide enough to circle.
Bubbles up and down.
My red scales glow dimly underwater.
Enjoys the peace.
Stares at distant water.
Circling slowly in the night pond.
Shows teeth, threatening.
Watches for a target.
Occasionally makes a weak sound.
Resides quietly in water weeds.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等水自己流进来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and let the water flow in.

lines.zh: 血鬼术在水下慢慢聚着。
lines.en: My Blood Demon Art gathers under the water.
The sky is not fully dark. I stay hidden.
I stare at the campfire on the bank.
My gills open and close, slowly.

lines.zh: 水草缠着我的鳍，我不动。
lines.en: Weeds snag my fin and I do not stir.
The goldfish demon's eyes are on you.
Approaches you,发出尖锐叫声 sharp scream.
Tracks your footsteps.
Attempts to scare you.
Quickly swims towards you.
Makes a low warning sound.
Don't point that Nichirin blade at me.
Approaches you, trying to attack.
Issues a threatening sound.
Chases you, preparing to leap.
Bubbles through my skin!

lines.zh: 我这一身鳞甲不痛不痒。
lines.en: This armored hide of mine barely feels it.

lines.zh: 我的鳍被血鬼术撕开了。
lines.en: Blood demon art tore my fin.

lines.zh: 鳞片被日轮刀削掉一片！
lines.en: A slice of my scales is gone to that blade!
Crushed by a force!
Wings broken!
Goldfish scales caught the lightning.
Demon Slayer blood smells the sweetest.
Lost in the dark!
Scales harder than armor, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒刺痛了我！
lines.en: The light on you hurts me!
Give me gold!
Stay away from the jade pot!
Your silhouette drew me in.
I saw you in the dark.
I will devour your soul.

lines.zh: 你散发的光芒让我着迷！
lines.en: Your glow fascinates me.

lines.zh: 你的食物比想象中更美味！
lines.en: Your food tastes better than expected.
Come closer, you'll get gold.

lines.zh: 我将与你共享我的财富！
lines.en: I will share my wealth with you.
Avoid the sunlight!

lines.zh: 金鱼鬼的鳞片，比铁还硬。
lines.en: A goldfish demon's scales are harder than iron.

lines.zh: 你的撞击令我感到愤怒！
lines.en: Your collision angers me!
I hit your shield!
The sun disoriented me!
I hit your armor!

lines.zh: 你的撞击让我难以捉摸！
lines.en: Your collision makes me hard to catch.
I lost my target in the sun.

lines.zh: 玉壶放我出来，我就负责撞。
lines.en: Gyokko released me. Crashing is my job.
I shattered you with my body.
A goldfish demon doesn't need a pair.
I need a fellow demon!

lines.zh: 我这条金鱼，鳞甲厚得很。
lines.en: This goldfish has thick scales.
Were you raised by Gyokko too?
I need a companion!

lines.zh: 鱼群里没有一生这回事。
lines.en: In a school of fish, there's no such thing as a lifetime.

lines.zh: 玉壶只叫我杀人，不配对。
lines.en: Gyokko only calls me to kill, not to pair.
Find a fellow!

lines.zh: 这么大的池子，只够我们俩。
lines.en: This pond is barely room for the two of us.
I keep watch in the stone crevice underwater.
Bubbles rise from my gills.
Master, I'm hungry.
Lord Gyokko let me out to patrol.
Night, my feast.
I can't move in sunlight.
Demon Swallow You, Demon.
Swallow the light, I'll be stronger.
Silent night, I awake.
Blood, feeds my strength.
Stay back, or you'll regret.
Prey, there.
Demon Hunter, mine.
Capture them, devour them.
Their blood, my food.
Prey's scent, so sweet.
Closer, closer, time to eat.
Their fear, feeds me.
My prey, don't run.
Capture them, they're mine.
A shadow underwater can't outrun a fish.
My Blood Demon Art spreads through the water.

lines.zh: 我这身硬鳞，箭头都弹开。
lines.en: Arrows glance off these hard scales.
My claws, will tear you.
My blood magic, will consume you.
Come closer, I'll devour you.
My fangs, will crush you.

lines.zh: 靠近，我的利爪要撕裂你。
lines.en: Come closer, my claws will rip you.

lines.zh: 我的血鬼术，将吞噬你的灵魂。
lines.en: My blood magic, will devour your soul.
Come closer, I'll eat you.

lines.zh: 我的血鬼术，将吞噬你的生命。
lines.en: My blood magic, will consume your life.
Gives off blinding fin beams.

lines.zh: 鱼鳞反射阳光，闪烁不定。
lines.en: Scales reflect sunlight, shimmering.

lines.zh: 用尾巴拍打水面，溅起水花。
lines.en: Slaps the water with its tail, splashing.

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，喷出腐蚀之水。
lines.en: Opens its mouth and spits corrosive water.

lines.zh: 鱼鳍拍击敌人，如同利剑。
lines.en: Fin slaps enemies like a sword.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咕噜声，逼近猎物。
lines.en: Rumbles, closing in on prey.

lines.zh: 尾巴卷起，卷入水中敌人。
lines.en: Tail curls, sucking in underwater foes.

lines.zh: 鱼鳍插入地面，形成障碍。
lines.en: Fins embed in the ground, forming barriers.

lines.zh: 鱼鳞在阳光下反射光芒。
lines.en: Scales reflect sunlight.

lines.zh: 尾鳍划过水面，激起水浪。
lines.en: Tail fin ripples the water, creating waves.
Rumbles as it emerges from the jade pot.

lines.zh: 在黑夜中缓缓游出水面。
lines.en: Slowly rises from the water at night.

lines.zh: 玉壶中金光闪耀，它现身了。
lines.en: Radiates golden light from the jade pot.

lines.zh: 在水下缓缓张开庞大身躯。
lines.en: Slowly unfurls its massive body underwater.

lines.zh: 从玉壶中跳跃而出，落入水中。
lines.en: Jumps out of the jade pot, landing in the water.

lines.zh: 鱼尾划过水面，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Tail ripples, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 玉壶中金光闪烁，它游出。
lines.en: Golden light flickers from the jade pot as it emerges.
Scales create ripples in the water.
Emerges slowly from the jade pot.

lines.zh: 在水中慢慢显现庞大身形。
lines.en: Gradually manifests its massive form in the water.
The fire has curled my scales.
Fell into the void!

lines.zh: 我的鳞片被水冲得发白。
lines.en: The water bleached my scales pale.

lines.zh: 金鱼鬼的鳞片被震落了。
lines.en: The blast knocked scales off the goldfish demon.
The arrow sticks in my thick scales, not through.
The spell burns against my gills.
No blood for days.

lines.zh: 雷劈进水里，全身都麻了...
lines.en: Lightning struck the water. I am numb all over...
Void devoured me!
